draft.title: Somatic and autonomic nervous systems
card: The peripheral nervous system has two main parts: the somatic and the autonomic nervous systems.
carries sensory messages from the skin, eyes, ears and other receptors in to the central nervous system. It also carries messages out to the skeletal muscles, which the person moves voluntarily.
carries messages to and from the organs and glands, such as the heart, stomach and sweat glands. It works without conscious effort, so a person does not need to think about it.
A single event can use both. Feeling a hot pan on your hand is a somatic message in. A change in your heart rate afterwards is run by the autonomic system.
draft.remember: Somatic: senses in and voluntary movement out. Autonomic: organs and glands, with no conscious effort.

a.q: Which task is controlled by the autonomic nervous system?
opts: Digesting a meal in the stomach
Kicking a football to a teammate
Feeling the texture of a rough towel
Turning your head to a loud noise
a.why: The stomach is an organ, and digestion runs without conscious effort, so it is autonomic. Kicking a football is tempting because it feels automatic once learned, but it is a voluntary movement of skeletal muscle, so it is somatic.
a.clue: Which one happens in an organ without you choosing it?

b.q: Zara reads a text message, then taps a reply with her thumb. While she waits for an answer, her heart rate rises slightly. Which pairing is correct?
opts: Reading: somatic. Tapping: somatic. Heart rate: autonomic
Reading: somatic. Tapping: autonomic. Heart rate: somatic
Reading: autonomic. Tapping: somatic. Heart rate: autonomic
Reading: autonomic. Tapping: autonomic. Heart rate: somatic
b.why: Reading brings sensory messages in from the eyes, and tapping is a voluntary movement of muscle, so both are somatic. Heart rate is run by the autonomic system without conscious effort. The pairings that call tapping autonomic wrongly treat a chosen movement as automatic.
b.clue: Sort each action by whether it is sensed or chosen, or run by an organ.

a.best: Digesting a meal in the stomach

b.best: Reading: somatic. Tapping: somatic. Heart rate: autonomic
